import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('input.csv')
totals = df.groupby('category')['est_cost'].sum()
print(totals.to_string())

assert totals.sum() == df['est_cost'].sum()
assert (totals >= 0).all()
assert set(totals.index) <= set('ABCDEFG')
